recalled_knowledge.item: NEST v2 ER exciton-to-ion ratio alpha = 0.067366 + 0.039693*rho (0.182 at 2.9 g/cm3)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: NEST v2 source code / Szydagis et al. 2023

recalled_knowledge.item: NEST GetQuanta recombination variance form Var(Ne) = r(1-r)Ni + sigma_p^2 Ni^2 with (skew-)Gaussian sampling
recalled_knowledge.reliability: likely (calibration factor k=0.5 needed to match the drawn LZ band, so the exact v2.4.5 form is uncertain)

recalled_knowledge.item: 124Xe 2nuECEC capture-shell branching KK 0.724, KL 0.200, KM+KN 0.056, LL+LM+MM 0.020
Te atomic binding energies K 31.8 keV, L 4.9 keV, M 1.0 keV; mode energies KL 36.7, KM 33.2, LL 9.8 keV
125I decays by EC to the 35.5 keV level of 125Te (K:L+M capture ~80:20), 100% to that level; the level de-excites mostly by internal conversion
125Xe decay gamma lines 188, 243, 55 keV; 127Xe 203/375 keV + 33 keV K-shell; 131mXe 164 keV; 129mXe 236 keV; 133Xe beta + 81 keV gamma; 83mKr 32.1 + 9.4 keV
LZ 2025 inner-shell-vacancy paper reports charge-yield reductions of order 10-20% for EC lines relative to beta ERs
W = 13.7 eV (NEST) and 13.5 eV (literature) work functions; nestpy's own W = 13.44 eV measured in this work

failed_or_abandoned: Using the Table S4 sigma_p directly as omega in Var(Ne) = r(1-r)Ni + omega^2 Ni^2 (k = 1) over-predicts the drawn Fig.4 band width by x2 and the observed ROI leakage at 250-500 phd by x4-20; demoted to an upper bound, replaced by the k = 0.50 calibration.
Interpreting the Table S4 alpha_i as skewness parameters of the Ne distribution: they parametrise sigma_p(x) only; the negative-skew variant is kept solely as a heavy-tail toy.
Counting Fig.4 black points by pixel blobs: unreliable where points overlap (250-330 phd); used only to confirm the empty gap region.
Deriving the absolute 125I decay count from the paper alone: not possible (degenerate with the enhancement f); replaced by a (f, N) scan over 10^2-10^4 decays.
First script run failed on DataFrame.tail name collision and a keyword-argument syntax error (fixed).
